In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the relA mutation is a nonsense or insertion mutation in the relA structural gene, that this relA mutant has a basal ppGpp pool of 70 to 100%, and that this mutant has a relaxed phenotype.
the relA locus is the locus of the gene for ppGpp synthetase, and that ppGpp is the product of this gene.
the relA locus is not an essential gene.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have isolated a series of relA mutants, all of which are defective in the synthesis of high level ppGPP.
the relA locus codes for a protein which, in the presence of deacylated tRNAs, is able to synthesize ppGpp.
the stringent control system of E. coli can be dissected into three parts: the stringent factor, the relA gene product, and the tRNA.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the relA region of E. coli is an interesting and complex one, and that we have a useful system to explore its properties.
the relA and relAins mutants have a normal doubling time and are not defective in their ability to grow on minimal media or to shift down.
